synopsis: Project Chrono provides SCM, CRM and DEM terrain models [f9123, f15988]. The glossary describes CRM as Chrono’s version of SPH and related continuum methods, which represent flowing soil with particles [f15984]. Developers report that higher-fidelity CRM terrain runs 50–200 times slower than real time, indicating a substantial simulation-time burden [f8499, f15989]. Chapter 11 identifies an NVIDIA GPU requirement and flags this vendor-specific dependency; the glossary repeats the requirement but leaves the maker unnamed [f8500, f15989].

relations.note: Both list SCM, CRM and DEM as Project Chrono terrain models.
Both report developer estimates of CRM running 50–200 times slower than real time.
Chapter 11 names NVIDIA as the GPU maker left unnamed in the glossary.
The glossary explains the particle-based continuum method behind the listed CRM terrain model.
